title: Multilingual Twitter Corpus and Baselines for Evaluating Demographic Bias in Hate Speech Recognition

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the equality differences (ED) of false positive and false negative rates in hate speech classification across binary age groups inferred from author profile images.
Measuring the equality differences (ED) of false positive and false negative rates in hate speech classification across male and female gender groups inferred from author profile images.

Measuring the equality differences (ED) of false positive and false negative rates in hate speech classification across geographic country origins (e.g., main country vs. non-main country) inferred from author profiles.

Measuring the equality differences (ED) of false positive and false negative rates in hate speech classification across racial groups (binarized as white and non-white) inferred from author profile images.
